# LiveAudioSkin

The live audio preset's default skin, which swaps time controls for a Live button

The default skin of the live audio preset: the audio layout with the time slider and time displays swapped for a Live button. The preset also provides [NeutralLiveAudioSkin](./live-audio-neutral-skin.md), [CompatLiveAudioSkin](./live-audio-compat-skin.md), and [ScaffoldLiveAudioSkin](./live-audio-scaffold-skin.md). See [Skins](../../guides/skins.md#choose-a-skin) to choose between them and [Presets](../../guides/presets.md) for what the live audio preset ships.

## Import

```tsx
import { LiveAudioSkin } from '@videojs/react/live-audio';
import '@videojs/react/live-audio/skin.css';
```

## Anatomy

The skin goes between the player and the media component. It renders its controls around the media.

```tsx
<LiveAudioPlayer>
  <LiveAudioSkin>
    <MuxAudio />
  </LiveAudioSkin>
</LiveAudioPlayer>
```

This uses the [Mux audio element](./mux-audio.md): a plain `<audio>` can’t play HLS in most browsers, and this element reports the live playback state the skin’s Live button needs. See [Play live streams](../../guides/live-streams.md).

## Styling

Packaged skins style themselves and expose a small set of public CSS custom properties. Everything else inside the skin is private and may change between releases. [Customize skins](../../guides/customize-skins.md#style-a-packaged-skin) documents the properties. For deeper changes, the Video.js registry provides the skin files.

## Examples

### Basic Usage

**App.tsx**

```tsx
import { LiveAudioPlayer, LiveAudioSkin } from '@videojs/react/live-audio';
import { MuxAudio } from '@videojs/react/media/mux-audio';

import '@videojs/react/live-audio/skin.css';

export default function BasicUsage() {
  return (
    <LiveAudioPlayer>
      <LiveAudioSkin className="react-live-audio-skin-basic">
        <MuxAudio src="https://stream.mux.com/v69RSHhFelSm4701snP22dYz2jICy4E4FUyk02rW4gxRM.m3u8" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
      </LiveAudioSkin>
    </LiveAudioPlayer>
  );
}
```

**App.css**

```css
.react-live-audio-skin-basic {
  width: 100%;
}
```

## Own the UI

Packaged skins keep their controls and layout inside Video.js. When you need to add, remove, rearrange, or deeply restyle controls, use Shadcn to add the skin source to your project. Its components, layout, styles, and interactions become local files you can change.

- [Install Video.js with Shadcn](../../guides/installation-shadcn.md#choose-how-to-install): Add editable skin source and build a working React or HTML player
